offDesc: When on, a topology frame (including visitor IPs) is recorded in memory every 5 seconds, using at most {mb} MiB; the oldest data is dropped beyond that. With little traffic it can cover a long time. Data is cleared on restart or when recording is turned off.
readonlyOff: An administrator needs to turn it on
waitDesc: The first frame will be ready within {s} seconds and shown automatically
skipIdleHelp: Skip periods with no traffic and no visitors during playback
recordHint: A frame every {s} seconds, kept only in memory, including visitor IPs and site and backend status; cleared on restart or when recording is turned off.
sizeHint: Kept by size: consecutive identical frames are stored once, so little traffic covers a long time and heavy traffic a shorter one.
disableConfirm: Turning recording off clears the recorded replay data. Turn it off?
